edges.note: TAKEN FROM constrained C3-N5 scan (rel to RC min, the E1 start). No first-order saddle located (未定位到一阶鞍点). Caveat: along this restricted coordinate the energy RISES MONOTONICALLY to +51.5 kcal at 3.60 A (still rising); the true C-N path maximum lies between 3.6 and 4.9 A, so 51.47 is a sampled value on the restricted path, NOT a converged internal maximum. The branch is also partly contaminated by proton migration. Low confidence. FINAL: no first-order saddle located. Routes tried: ts_prepare (ts_0001, xTB path never closes C3..N5 + validate), free OptTS from IDPP frames (wandered on spectator libration), OptTS from the C3-N5=3.6 A scan-peak seed (job 614, see log). The C3-N5 scan profile is monotonic-rising (restricted path, partly proton-migration-contaminated) and is NOT a barrier. (OptTS from the C3-N5=3.6 A peak seed, job 614, did not converge.) Retry: constrained C3-N5=2.2 A geometry then OptTS (job 638) did not converge.

edges.note: FIRST-ORDER SADDLE LOCATED (carbinolamine-O protonation sub-step of E2). From a constrained geometry (C3-O4=2.10 A, O4-H=1.30 A, from I1-min) unconstrained OptTS (Calc_Hess) converged: E(TS2)=-440.571648790635 Ha, exactly 1 imaginary frequency (-283.64 cm-1). TS geometry: O1-H2=1.218, O4-H2=1.201 (proton midway between H3O+ and the carbinolamine O), C3-O4=1.53, C3-N5=1.39 -> a proton-transfer saddle. IRC (job 654) both directions converged but SHORT (10/11 pts); endB relaxes (job 656, 0 imag) to a minimum at -440.571815 (+13.84 vs I1, a proton-transferred structure), endF op did not converge -> connectivity to I1/I2 only partially established. dE#=13.94 kcal vs I1.

FIRST-ORDER SADDLE LOCATED AND VERIFIED. Built a constrained H-transfer bridge geometry (O12-H14 = C10-H14 = 1.40 A, from I2-min) then unconstrained OptTS (Calc_Hess): E(TS3)=-440.466782582659 Ha, exactly 1 imaginary frequency (-2140.76 cm-1, stiff proton-transfer mode). IRC (job 637) converged BOTH directions (42 fwd / 46 bwd); outer frames optimised (jobs 639/640, 0 imag): endB -> I2 minimum (-440.578236124461, dE=0.00 vs delivered I2), endF -> I3-type enol conformer (-440.559122588528, -2.02 kcal vs delivered I3). dE#(E3) = E(TS3)-E(I2) = 69.94 kcal (pure electronic). Enolisation is the highest computed barrier (uncatalysed 1,3-H shift). REVIEW CHECK: TS3 geometry has C10-H14=1.501 A, O12-H14=1.315 A, C10-C11=1.402 A, C11-O12=1.297 A -> genuine alpha-C-H -> O proton-transfer (enolisation) coordinate; IRC endB -> I2 (dE 0.00) and endF -> I3-type enol confirm connectivity. CAVEAT: the barrier (69.9 kcal) is high and the imaginary mode (-2140 cm-1) is stiff because this is the uncatalysed 1,3-H shift at this level; value retained (verified by 1-imag + bidirectional IRC), flagged as unusually high.

edges.note: FIRST-ORDER SADDLE LOCATED in the C-C approach region but CONNECTIVITY NOT ESTABLISHED. From a constrained geometry (C1-C10=2.20 A, from I3-min) unconstrained OptTS (Calc_Hess) converged: E(TS4)=-440.550526782986 Ha, exactly 1 imaginary frequency (-363.63 cm-1); TS geometry C1-C10=1.963 A, C1-N2=1.347, C10-C11=1.390, C11-O12=1.293 (C-C forming). IRC (job 647) both directions converged (32/8) BUT both outer frames optimise (jobs 650/651, 0 imag) back to I3 minima (-440.555351 / -440.555531, dE +0.35/+0.23 vs I3) -> the saddle does NOT connect I3 to I4; it is a preorganisation/approach saddle. dE#=3.37 kcal vs I3 retained as the located-saddle value but the productive I3->I4 step is not verified.

BEST-AVAILABLE VALUE = constrained-scan upper bound 3.87 kcal vs I4 (converged O6-H constrained optimisations: 0.97/1.30/1.60/2.00 A -> 0/+1.09/+0.32/+3.87 kcal vs I4). This is the strongest evidence available for E5: the O6-H -> water proton transfer is near-barrierless. A separate stationary point with 1 imaginary freq (-56.48 cm-1) was found but is a SOFT PROTON MODE of the loose multi-fragment complex (coordinator review: imaginary-mode displacement dominated by hydrogens, heavy-atom total 0.888), NOT the E5 saddle, and its IRC does not connect to P; it is therefore not adopted. No first-order saddle for the productive E5 step was located; the scan upper bound is a legitimate weak value (unresolved, low confidence). FINAL: no first-order saddle located for the PRODUCTIVE step. Routes tried: OptTS from the O6-H=1.30 A seed (job 579) gave only a SOFT multi-fragment proton mode (-56.48 cm-1, heavy-atom displacement 0.888) that does not connect to P; scan profile (O6-H) kept for audit. No barrier claimed. Retry route: constrained H-bridge geometry (O6-H=1.40, H...O17=1.40) then OptTS (job 652) did not converge.

closure_note: Species minima complete and validated (0 imaginary). No verified elementary-step TS for E1-E4; E5 has a 1-imag saddle whose connectivity to P is not established. E2 upper bound from constrained scan; E5 weak value from a located saddle + scan.
